sentences.en: He has been a gossip columnist for nine years now.
sentences.zh: 1. 他已经当了九年的八卦专栏作家。

sentences.en: They are both well-known columnists, but they work at rival newspapers.
sentences.zh: 2. 他们都是著名的专栏作家，但他们在竞争的报纸工作。

sentences.en: In some countries, an advice columnist is known as an agony aunt.
sentences.zh: 3. 在一些国家里，一位建议专栏作家被称为 agony aunt（烦恼顾问）
